home.noPriceMeta: Products using them cannot be sold

products.label: Size
products.noGroups: No modifier groups yet. Create them under Modifiers.
products.noRecipeHint: This size has no recipe, so it cannot be sold. Add a recipe, or untick "Track stock" if it uses no stock.
products.subtitle: Build your menu from the stock you already manage.
products.note: Products are sold at the POS. Raw ingredients stay separate stock items.
products.pick: Choose a product on the left, or add a new one.
products.editHint: Edit product details and the per-serving recipe of each size.
products.name: Product name

typeHints.made: Made from a recipe; each sale deducts its ingredients.
typeHints.stock: Sold as bought (e.g. a croissant): one stock item × 1 per sale.
typeHints.none: A service item: it sells with no stock deduction.
typeHints.mixed: Sizes use different types. Choose one to apply it to all sizes.

products.mixedHint: This size has its own type. Pick a product type above to make all sizes the same.
products.untrackedSize: No stock tracking: this size sells without deducting any stock.
products.recipeInfo: Saving a recipe does not consume stock. Ingredients are deducted only when a sale is completed.
products.slotHint: Only needed when a replace option swaps this line (e.g. milk for Oat Milk).
products.stockItemHint: Pick the stock item (counted in pieces). Each sale deducts 1.
products.previewNote: Preview only, without modifiers (e.g. Oat Milk). Nothing is deducted.
products.stockRuleTitle: If stock is not enough, the sale still goes through.
products.stockRule: The balance goes below zero and the till shows a warning. Record a purchase or a stock adjustment to correct it.
products.unsavedConfirm: You have unsaved changes on this product. Leave and lose them?
products.filterNoRecipe: Showing only products with a size that has no recipe (these cannot be sold).
products.noCostRow: No cost yet: post a purchase or enter an opening balance with its value.

costBar.title: Recipe cost and margin
costBar.exTax: Profit and margin use the price without tax.
costBar.note: Gross profit before operating expenses (rent, salaries, utilities) — open <l>Profit Report →</l> for Net Profit.

products.noCost: No price yet for: {{names}}. Post a purchase or enter an opening balance with its value; until then this size cannot be sold.
products.costNote: At today's average cost of each ingredient.

ingredients.costHint: The cost comes from purchases and opening balances (with their value). It is never typed here.
ingredients.unitLocked: The unit cannot change after creation.
ingredients.note: Stock comes in by purchases and opening balances, and goes out by sales, waste and counts.

inventory.deltaHint: A loss: it lowers profit at the average cost.
inventory.countHint: The system works out the difference. A shortage is a loss; extra stock only fixes the balance (never profit).
inventory.openingNote: Stock that is in the café without a purchase: at the start, or later (a gift, found in storage). Its total value is required, so every gram has a cost. It is not money out and never profit.
inventory.openingInvalid: Each line needs a quantity and a total value greater than 0.
inventory.addWarning: Stock is never added here. Bought it? Record it as a purchase. Already had it? Use Opening balances with its value.
inventory.openingReasonNeeded: Required: some of these ingredients already have stock.
inventory.openingReasonHint: Optional for the first opening balance, e.g. "Gift from the roaster" later on.

users.resetNote: The user will be logged out of all devices.

settings.taxRateInvalid: Tax rate must be a number between 0 and 100.
settings.cardFeeHint: Saved on each card sale and counted as a cost in Profit. Changing it never changes past sales.
settings.cardFeeInvalid: The card fee must be a number between 0 and 100.

errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.PERMISSION_DENIED: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.LAST_ADMIN: The last active admin cannot be deactivated or demoted.
errors.CANNOT_DEACTIVATE_SELF: You cannot deactivate your own account.
errors.SHIFT_NOT_OPEN: You need an open shift for this. Open one at the point of sale.
errors.SHIFT_ALREADY_OPEN: You already have an open shift.
errors.PRICE_CHANGED: The price changed. Review the new total.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED: The request is missing its safety key. Reload the page.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: This request key was already used for a different sale.
errors.INVALID_QUANTITY: Quantity must be a whole number from 1 to 99.
errors.ITEM_UNAVAILABLE: An item in the cart is no longer available.
errors.INVALID_MODIFIER: An option in the cart cannot be sold with this product (not available or not set up). Ask an Admin.
errors.MODIFIER_SELECTION_INVALID: Check the number of options chosen.
errors.PAYMENT_MISMATCH: The payments do not add up to the total.
errors.PURCHASE_NOT_EDITABLE: A posted purchase cannot be edited or deleted.
errors.PURCHASE_CHANGED: This purchase was changed while posting. Reload it and post again.
errors.EXPENSE_NOT_VOIDABLE: This expense cannot be voided (purchase expense, already voided, or its shift is closed).
errors.RECIPE_MISSING: A size in the cart has no recipe, so it cannot be sold. Ask an Admin.
errors.REGISTER_NOT_CONFIGURED: No single default register is set up for this café. Ask an Admin.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on the server. Please try again.
errors.INGREDIENT_IN_USE: This ingredient is used by these recipes or options. Remove it from them first:
errors.PURCHASE_NOT_VOIDABLE: This purchase cannot be voided (a draft, already voided, or paid from a shift that is already closed).
errors.CASH_MOVEMENT_NOT_VOIDABLE: This cannot be cancelled (already cancelled, or the shift is closed).
errors.COST_MISSING: An ingredient in this cart has no price yet, so it cannot be sold. Ask an Admin.
errors.PAYMENT_EXCEEDS_OWED: The payment is more than what is owed for this purchase.
errors.PAYMENT_NOT_ALLOWED: This payment cannot be made or voided.
errors.STOCK_RETURN_NOT_ALLOWED: Stock cannot be returned for this order.

recipe.pickIngredient: Choose an ingredient on every line.
recipe.wasteInvalid: Waste must be a number from 0 to 100.
recipe.slotInvalid: A slot uses letters, numbers, - or _ only.
recipe.slotMissing: The group “{{group}}” replaces the slot “{{slot}}”, but this recipe has no line with that slot.

modifiers.help: Reusable option groups. Link them to products on the product page.
modifiers.saveFirst: Save the group to add options.
modifiers.slotHint: The slot key used in recipes, e.g. milk.
modifiers.slotWarningsText: These sizes have no recipe line with the slot “{{slot}}”, so selling this group with them fails
modifiers.label: Option
modifiers.sizePricesHint: Overrides the extra price for one size.
modifiers.effectsHint: What this option consumes. “All sizes” applies when a size has no row of its own. An option with no rows cannot be sold unless “No stock effect” is ticked (in a replace group it then only removes the slot, e.g. No milk).
modifiers.noStockEffect: No stock effect (deducts nothing, e.g. "No ice")
modifiers.noIngredientHint: This option has no ingredient, so it cannot be sold. Add an effect, or tick "No stock effect".
modifiers.effectRequired: Add at least one ingredient effect, or tick "No stock effect".

pos.cartEmpty: Add products to start an order.
pos.tenderedShort: The cash received is less than the total.
pos.cardNote: Charge the card on the terminal first.
pos.mixedInvalid: Cash must be more than 0 and less than the total.
pos.checkingText: Please wait. Do not take payment again.
pos.unconfirmed: Could not confirm the last sale. Do not take payment again. Check the connection, then tap Retry. Selling is paused until it is confirmed.
pos.priceChangedText: Prices changed since you built this order. Review the new total, then take payment again.
pos.noShift: No open shift. Open your shift to start selling.
pos.openShiftText: Count the cash in the drawer and enter it to start your shift.
pos.lowStock: Low stock (the sale still goes through):
pos.noPaymentNeeded: No payment needed for a 0.00 order.
pos.panelLocked: Finish or retry the current sale first.
pos.drawerNeedsShift: Open a shift to pay from the drawer.
pos.ordersNoteAdmin: All orders, newest first. Search an invoice number to find one.
pos.openShiftLast: Your last shift closed on {{time}} with {{amount}} counted.

orders.baristaNote: Today's orders. Search an invoice number to find an older one.
orders.refundUnsure: We could not confirm the refund. Do not refund again by hand: tap Retry to check.
orders.refundCardWarning: Card refunds must be done on the card terminal by staff.
orders.refundCashNote: The cash is taken from your open shift.
orders.refundStockWarning: Stock is not returned. An Admin can adjust stock if the item is reusable.
orders.returnNote: Put back what was not used (e.g. a sealed bottle). At most what this order used; it goes back at the cost it left at and lowers the cost of sales. Once per order.
orders.returnNothing: Type a quantity for at least one ingredient.
orders.returnTooMuch: Each quantity must be more than 0 and not more than what was used.

shift.shortage: Shortage: the drawer has less cash than expected.
shift.overage: Overage: the drawer has more cash than expected.
shift.closeText: Count the cash in your drawer and enter it. You cannot sell after closing.
shift.closeOther: You are closing {{name}}'s shift. Enter the cash counted for it.
shift.goPos: Open a shift at the point of sale

expenses.drawerNote: Paid in cash from your drawer. It lowers your expected cash and needs your open shift.
expenses.voidNote: Voiding removes it from reports and from an open shift's expected cash. It cannot be undone.
expenses.stockHint: Bought stock (milk, coffee, cups…)? Record it as a purchase, from the drawer if paid from it, so the stock and its cost go in.

suppliers.payNothing: Type an amount for at least one purchase.
suppliers.payInvalid: Each amount must be more than 0 and not more than what is owed.
suppliers.payUnsure: We could not confirm the payment. Tap Retry: it is safe, it will not pay twice.
suppliers.nothingOwed: Nothing is owed to this supplier.
suppliers.voidNote: Voiding the payment of {{amount}} makes it owed again and cancels its expense.

purchases.postedNote: Posted {{time}} by {{by}}. Stock and the expense were recorded once.
purchases.rowInvalid: Each item needs an ingredient, a quantity and a cost.
purchases.drawerNote: A drawer purchase uses your own open shift when you post.
purchases.packHint: Type the quantity and what you paid for it; the system works out the cost per unit. By pack: packs × pack size at a price per pack.
purchases.postWarning: Posting adds the stock and records an expense of {{total}}. It cannot be undone or edited.
purchases.postUnsure: We could not confirm the post. Tap Retry: it is safe, it will not post twice.
purchases.voidText: The purchased stock goes back out (it can go below zero if some was used) and the expense of {{total}} is cancelled. This cannot be undone.
purchases.creditHint: The stock and its cost go in when posted; the money goes out when you pay the supplier.
purchases.creditNeedsSupplier: A purchase on credit needs its supplier.
purchases.postWarningCredit: Posting adds the stock now. Nothing is paid now: {{total}} is owed to the supplier. It cannot be undone or edited.

reports.stockNote: Balances are current. The date range only affects the consumed column.

notes.money-in-out: Every pound in and out: sales by sale date, refunds by refund date, expenses and purchases by paid date. Voided ones are left out.
notes.profit: What the sales earned: net sales − cost of what was sold (average purchase price, saved on every sale) − losses − expenses. Stock that comes in is never profit.

money.netNegative: More went out than came in
money.drawerNote: Cash put in or taken out of drawers only moves cash (e.g. to the safe), so it is not counted as money in or out.

reports.purchasesInfo: Stock bought in this period: {{amount}} (it becomes a cost when sold or lost, so it is not subtracted here).
reports.missingOrders_one: {{count}} order ({{amount}}) has no saved cost, so the cost and profit can't be calculated.
reports.missingOrders_other: {{count}} orders ({{amount}}) have no saved cost, so the cost and profit can't be calculated.
reports.missingAdjustments_one: {{count}} stock change has no cost, so the net profit can't be calculated.
reports.missingAdjustments_other: {{count}} stock changes have no cost, so the net profit can't be calculated.
reports.estimatedOrders_one: {{count}} order has a cost recalculated later from the average cost (an estimate).
reports.estimatedOrders_other: {{count}} orders have a cost recalculated later from the average cost (an estimate).
reports.per100: {{cost}} cost of what was sold · {{losses}} losses · {{expenses}} expenses · {{profit}} profit
reports.returnedInfo: Already less {{amount}} returned to stock after refunds.
reports.stockAddedInfo: Stock added by counts or later opening balances: {{amount}} (not profit).

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Who did what, and when. Click a line to see the details.

sentences.shift_opened: Opened a shift with {{cash}} in the drawer
sentences.purchase_posted: Posted a purchase of {{total}} ({{items}} item(s)), paid from: {{source}}
sentences.cash_removed: Took {{amount}} out of the drawer · Reason: “{{reason}}”
sentences.supplier_payment_voided: Voided a payment of {{amount}} to {{supplier}} · Reason: “{{reason}}”

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.intro: Shortcuts do not work while you type in a box, except Esc, Ctrl+Enter and the F-keys. They work the same with the Arabic keyboard.

items.goOrders: Orders / Refund (on the POS: opens the panel)
items.goShift: Shift & Close (on the POS: opens the panel)
items.qtyUp: Quantity +1 on the last cart line
items.qtyDown: Quantity −1 on the last cart line
items.rows: Move between rows, Enter opens one

alerts.title: Needs attention
alerts.noRecipe_one: {{count}} size without a recipe (cannot be sold)
alerts.noRecipe_other: {{count}} sizes without a recipe (cannot be sold)
alerts.noPrice_one: {{count}} ingredient has no price (cannot be sold)
alerts.noPrice_other: {{count}} ingredients have no price (cannot be sold)

cash.title: Cash out / in
cash.note: Cash leaving or entering your drawer that is not a sale, refund or expense, e.g. cash to the safe or change from the owner. It changes your expected cash; it is not an expense.
cash.gapOut: Last close counted {{previous}}, but this shift opened with {{opening}}: {{amount}} left the drawer between the shifts.
cash.gapIn: Last close counted {{previous}}, but this shift opened with {{opening}}: {{amount}} was added between the shifts.
cash.gapHint: Opening cash vs. the same person's previous count
